title: Correction: Nutritional Recommendations (NutriRECS) on Consumption of Red and Processed Meat
result: Published online 31 December 2019, in print 4 February 2020. On the disclosure forms of the six NutriRECS articles on red and processed meat, Bradley Johnston did not indicate a grant from Texas A&M AgriLife Research to fund investigator-driven research related to saturated and polyunsaturated fats; the funding period started within the 36-month reporting period of the ICMJE disclosure form. The updated forms include this grant and funding from the International Life Science Institute (North America) that ended before the 36-month reporting period.
